description: Get a tax capital allowance hint for a fixed asset (book depreciation vs tax relief). GB companies get AIA/WDA guidance from official rates; other countries get a jurisdiction note. Use when the user asks about capital allowances, AIA, or tax relief on a specific asset — not a filing computation.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: get_capital_allowance_hint
